_doc: Snapshot 2026-05-08. Prices are seeded from public benchmarks: Pepper.pl, Blix.pl, gazetki.pl (PL), Kaufda.de, mydealz.de, supermarktcheck.de (DE), Carrefour.fr/.es/.it product pages, supermarktscanner.nl (NL), tulistadelmerca.es (ES), world-prices.com (ES), discounto.de. Each `_source_note` cites the specific public reference. Where direct retailer pricing was paywalled or behind login, range midpoint from at least 2 independent benchmarks was used and flagged with `_seeded: 'benchmark_range'`. No fabricated prices. The /fmcg-arbitrage slash command refreshes this file by re-querying public sources via WebSearch + WebFetch. | Includes embedded catalog (brands+variants) and markets so the static site needs only one fetch.

PL.name: Polska
PL._vat_note: Coca-Cola/Red Bull at 23% standard. Coca-Cola Zero (no sugar) typically also 23% as it's still a beverage. Nutella at 5% reduced food rate (chocolate spread is in załącznik 10 of Polish VAT act).

sugar_tax.law: ustawa o opłacie od środków spożywczych (opłata cukrowa)

PL._sugar_tax_note: Government's 2026 hike (caffeine/taurine surcharge from 0.10 to 1.00 PLN/L) was vetoed by President Nawrocki Dec 2025; current rates remain in force.

ftl_b2b._doc: Full Truckload palletized — €/km from each origin to PL hub (Warsaw/Łódź distribution centre)

parcel_consumer._doc: Per-package courier (DPD/UPS/InPost) for consumer-scale single-case shipments (≤30kg)

DE.name: Deutschland
DE._vat_note: Beverages (sugary or not) at 19% standard rate. Plant-based and dairy drinks at 7% but Coca-Cola/Red Bull are at 19%. Nutella (food product) at 7% reduced rate.

sugar_tax._note: Germany has no national SSB tax as of 2026. Health-policy debate ongoing but no implementation.

FR.name: France
FR._vat_note: Cold non-alcoholic beverages and food sold for off-premise consumption at 5.5% reduced food rate. Restaurant/on-premise would be 10% but POC assumes retail off-premise.

sugar_tax.law: taxe sur les boissons sucrées (Loi 2018) + taxe sur boissons contenant de la taurine
sugar_tax._note: Taurine surcharge ~€1.00/L applies to Red Bull regardless of sugar variant — major distortion vs other countries.

IT.name: Italia
IT._vat_note: Carbonated soft drinks and energy drinks at 22% standard rate (NOT in 10% reduced food list — only mineral water and milk get 10%). Nutella at 10% (chocolate-based food).

sugar_tax._note: Italian sugar tax (€10/hl on SSB exceeding 25g/L) was scheduled for Jan 2026, deferred to Jan 2027 in the latest budget law. Currently NOT in force in 2026.

ES.name: España
ES._vat_note: Sugary drinks moved from 10% (food) to 21% (standard) in 2021 reform. Energy drinks at 21%. Nutella at 10% reduced food rate. Catalonia has additional regional sugar tax (8% on >8g sugar/100ml drinks) but POC uses national average.

sugar_tax._note: National Spain has no SSB tax in 2026 (sugary VAT increase was the substitute). Catalonia regional sugar tax exists but is hyper-local — POC ignores for national average.

NL.name: Nederland
NL._vat_note: Soft drinks at 21% standard. Mineral water moved to 21% in 2024. Nutella (food) at 9% reduced rate.

sugar_tax._note: Verbruiksbelasting raised in Jan 2024 from €0.0883/L to €0.2613/L (200% hike) on most non-alcoholic beverages including diet sodas. Mineral water exempted in 2024 reversal.
